const PASSWORD = process.env.PAYLOAD_ADMIN_PASSWORD

if (!EMAIL || !PASSWORD) {
  console.error('❌ Missing PAYLOAD_ADMIN_EMAIL or PAYLOAD_ADMIN_PASSWORD')
  process.exit(1)
}

async function login(): Promise&lt;string&gt; {
  const res = await fetch(&#96;${BASE_URL}/api/users/login&#96;, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email: EMAIL, password: PASSWORD }),
  })
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(&#96;Login failed: ${res.status}&#96;)
  const data = await res.json()
  return data.token
}

      }

    "version": 1
  }
}
```

_**User**_

/pm  WCC Payload Admin — Eliminate all HTML rendering, move to native Lexical

This is an architectural correction. All winery stories and article 
content is already in Payload as proper Lexical richText. The page 
components are currently converting Lexical to HTML before rendering.
That conversion must be eliminated entirely.

## Step 1 — Audit current Lexical rendering approach

Find every instance of HTML conversion in the codebase:

grep -rn "lexicalToHtml\|dangerouslySetInnerHTML\|storyHtml\|serializeHTML" \
  app/ lib/ components/ --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts"

List every file that appears. These all need to be updated.

## Step 2 — Check what Lexical renderer is available

cat package.json | grep -i "lexical\|payload\|rich"

Check if @payloadcms/richtext-lexical is already installed.
If not: npm install @payloadcms/richtext-lexical

Also check if there's already a RichText or lexical renderer 
component in the codebase:

find . -name "RichText*" -o -name "*lexical*" \
  | grep -v node_modules | grep -v ".next"

If there is one already — use it. Do not build a new one.
Check how articles render their body content since that is 
already working and use the exact same component and pattern.

## Step 3 — Create or verify the Lexical renderer component

The renderer should accept the raw Lexical JSON from Payload
and render it as React — no HTML string conversion at any point.

Pattern (using @payloadcms/richtext-lexical):

// components/RichText.tsx
import { RichText as PayloadRichText } from "@payloadcms/richtext-lexical/react"

export function RichText({ content }: { content: unknown }) {
  if (!content) return null
  return <PayloadRichText data={content} />
}

If the project uses a custom serializer instead, use that.
The point is: Lexical JSON in → React nodes out. No HTML anywhere.

## Step 4 — Update the InterleavedStory component

Replace the HTML-splitting approach with a Lexical-native approach.
The story should be split at heading nodes in the Lexical tree,
not by parsing HTML strings.

// components/winery/InterleavedStory.tsx

import { RichText } from "@/components/RichText"

interface LexicalNode {
  type: string
  children?: LexicalNode[]
  [key: string]: unknown
}

interface LexicalContent {
  root: { children: LexicalNode[] }
}

export function InterleavedStory({
  content,       // raw Lexical JSON from Payload
  editorialImages,
}: {
  content: LexicalContent
  editorialImages: EditorialImage[]
}) {
  if (!content?.root?.children) return null

  const nodes = content.root.children
  const sections: LexicalNode[][] = []
  let current: LexicalNode[] = []

  // Split node array at every heading node (h2, h3)
  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (node.type === "heading" && current.length > 0) {
      sections.push(current)
      current = [node]
    } else {
      current.push(node)
    }
  }
  if (current.length > 0) sections.push(current)

  // Image insertion slots — after sections 1, 3, 5, 7
  const imageSlots: Record<number, number> = {
    1: 0, 3: 1, 5: 2, 7: 3
  }

  return (
    <div className="story-content">
      {sections.map((section, i) => (
        <div key={i}>
          {/* Render this section natively via Lexical renderer */}
          <RichText
            content={{ root: { ...content.root, children: section } }}
          />

          {/* Insert editorial image after mapped sections */}
          {imageSlots[i] !== undefined &&
           editorialImages[imageSlots[i]] && (
            <EditorialImageBlock
              img={editorialImages[imageSlots[i]]}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

Replace with:

If nothing references it, delete the function.

We do not convert Lexical to HTML anywhere in this codebase.

```
import React from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Lexical node renderer
function renderLexicalNode(node: any, index: number): React.ReactNode {
  if (!node) return null

  // Text node
  if (node.type === "text" || (!node.type &amp;&amp; node.text)) {
    let content: React.ReactNode = node.text || ""
    if (node.format) {
      // Handle formatting flags
      if (node.format &amp; 1) content = &lt;strong key={&#96;b-${index}&#96;}&gt;{content}&lt;/strong&gt;
      if (node.format &amp; 2) content = &lt;em key={&#96;i-${index}&#96;}&gt;{content}&lt;/em&gt;
      if (node.format &amp; 8) content = &lt;u key={&#96;u-${index}&#96;}&gt;{content}&lt;/u&gt;
      if (node.format &amp; 16) content = &lt;code key={&#96;c-${index}&#96;} className="rounded bg-zinc-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-sm font-mono text-blue-300"&gt;{content}&lt;/code&gt;
    }
    return content
  }

  // Get children content
  const children = node.children?.map((child: any, i: number) =&gt; renderLexicalNode(child, i))

  // Handle different node types
  switch (node.type) {
    case "root":
      return &lt;div key={index}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;

    case "paragraph":
      return &lt;p key={index} className="mb-4 leading-relaxed text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/p&gt;

    case "heading":
    case "h1":
      return &lt;h1 key={index} className="mb-4 mt-8 text-3xl font-bold text-zinc-100"&gt;{children}&lt;/h1&gt;
    case "h2":
      return &lt;h2 key={index} className="mb-4 mt-6 text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-100"&gt;{children}&lt;/h2&gt;
    case "h3":
      return &lt;h3 key={index} className="mb-3 mt-5 text-xl font-bold text-zinc-100"&gt;{children}&lt;/h3&gt;
    case "h4":
      return &lt;h4 key={index} className="mb-3 mt-4 text-lg font-bold text-zinc-100"&gt;{children}&lt;/h4&gt;

    case "list":
      if (node.listType === "number") {
        return &lt;ol key={index} className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/ol&gt;
      }
      return &lt;ul key={index} className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/ul&gt;

    // SlateJS flat format used by our WordPress import
    case "ul":
      return &lt;ul key={index} className="mb-4 ml-6 list-disc space-y-2 text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/ul&gt;
    case "ol":
      return &lt;ol key={index} className="mb-4 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-2 text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/ol&gt;
    case "li":
    case "listitem":
      return &lt;li key={index}&gt;{children}&lt;/li&gt;

    case "blockquote":
    case "quote":
      return (
        &lt;blockquote key={index} className="my-6 border-l-4 border-blue-500 bg-zinc-800/50 py-3 pl-4 pr-4 italic text-zinc-300"&gt;
          {children}
        &lt;/blockquote&gt;
      )

    case "link":
      // Support both SlateJS flat format (node.url) and Lexical format (node.fields.url)
      const linkUrl = node.url || node.fields?.url || "#"
      return (
        &lt;a key={index} href={linkUrl} className="text-blue-400 underline hover:text-blue-300" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;
          {children}
        &lt;/a&gt;
      )

    case "code":
      return (
        &lt;pre key={index} className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 p-4 text-sm"&gt;
          &lt;code className="font-mono text-zinc-300"&gt;{children}&lt;/code&gt;
        &lt;/pre&gt;
      )

    case "horizontalrule":
      return &lt;hr key={index} className="my-8 border-zinc-700" /&gt;

    default:
      // For unknown types, try to render children or text
      if (children &amp;&amp; children.length &gt; 0) {
        return &lt;div key={index}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;
      }
      return null
  }
}

export function RichText({ data, className }: { data: any; className?: string }) {
  if (!data) return null

  const proseClass = cn("prose prose-invert max-w-none", className)

  // If it's already HTML, render safely
  if (typeof data === "string" &amp;&amp; data.trim().startsWith("&lt;")) {
    return &lt;div className={proseClass} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: data }} /&gt;
  }

  // Handle Payload Lexical shape: { root: { children: [...] } }
  if (data?.root?.children) {
    return (
      &lt;div className={proseClass}&gt;
        {data.root.children.map((node: any, i: number) =&gt; renderLexicalNode(node, i))}
      &lt;/div&gt;
    )
  }

  // Handle direct array of nodes (like our API-created content)
  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    return (
      &lt;div className={proseClass}&gt;
        {data.map((node: any, i: number) =&gt; renderLexicalNode(node, i))}
      &lt;/div&gt;
    )
  }

  // Fallback for unexpected formats
  if (typeof data === "object") {
    // Try to extract text from any structure
    const extractText = (obj: any): string =&gt; {
      if (typeof obj === "string") return obj
      if (obj?.text) return obj.text
      if (obj?.children) return obj.children.map(extractText).join("")
      if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(extractText).join("")
      return ""
    }
    const text = extractText(data)
    if (text) {
      return &lt;div className={proseClass}&gt;&lt;p className="text-zinc-300"&gt;{text}&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    }
  }

  // Ultimate fallback - show nothing rather than JSON
  return null
}

/**
 * Lexical JSON to HTML conversion utilities
 * Implements all node types from FRONTEND_BLOG_SEO_REQUIREMENTS.md
 */

const CMS_URL = (process.env.CMS_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYLOAD_URL || "").replace(/\/+$/, "")

interface LexicalNode {
  type?: string
  format?: number | string
  tag?: string
  text?: string
  url?: string
  // SlateJS inline formatting (boolean flags)
  bold?: boolean
  italic?: boolean
  underline?: boolean
  strikethrough?: boolean
  code?: boolean
  fields?: {
    url?: string
    newTab?: boolean
    linkType?: string
    caption?: string
  }
  value?: {
    id?: string | number
    url?: string
    alt?: string
    width?: number
    height?: number
  }
  children?: LexicalNode[]
  listType?: "bullet" | "number"
  direction?: string
  indent?: number
  version?: number
  relationTo?: string
}

function slugifyHeading(text: string): string {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 60)
}

}

/**
 * Extract headings from HTML for TOC generation
 */
export interface TOCHeading {
  id: string
  text: string
  level: number
}

export function extractHeadings(html: string): TOCHeading[] {
  const headings: TOCHeading[] = []
  const regex = /&lt;(h[2-3])[^&gt;]*id="([^"]*)"[^&gt;]*&gt;([\s\S]*?)&lt;\/\1&gt;/gi

  let match
  while ((match = regex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    headings.push({
      level: parseInt(match[1][1], 10),
      id: match[2],
      text: match[3].replace(/&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;/g, "").trim(),
    })
  }

  return headings
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { slugify } from '@/lib/slugify'

type SlateNode = {
  type?: string
  tag?: string
  children?: SlateNode[]
  text?: string
  [key: string]: unknown
}

interface TOCHeading {
  id: string
  text: string
  level: number
}

function isSlateArray(data: unknown): data is SlateNode[] {
  return Array.isArray(data)
}

function collectText(node: SlateNode): string {
  if (typeof node.text === 'string') return node.text
  if (Array.isArray(node.children)) return node.children.map(collectText).join('')
  return ''
}

function extractHeadingsFromSlate(nodes: SlateNode[]): TOCHeading[] {
  const headings: TOCHeading[] = []
  for (const node of nodes) {
    const type = typeof node.type === 'string' ? node.type : ''
    // Handle both 'h2' type and 'heading' type with tag
    let level = 0
    if (type === 'h2') level = 2
    else if (type === 'h3') level = 3
    else if (type === 'h4') level = 4
    else if (type === 'heading') {
      const tag = node.tag || ''
      if (tag === 'h2') level = 2
      else if (tag === 'h3') level = 3
      else if (tag === 'h4') level = 4
    }

    if (level) {
      const text = collectText(node).trim()
      if (text) headings.push({ id: slugify(text), text, level })
    }
  }
  return headings
}

function extractHeadingsFromLexical(root: { children?: SlateNode[] }): TOCHeading[] {
  if (!root?.children) return []
  return extractHeadingsFromSlate(root.children)
}

interface ArticleLayoutProps {
  article: Article

/** Detect WordPress TOC widget output masquerading as an excerpt */
function isTableOfContentsExcerpt(text?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!text) return false
  const t = text.trim().toLowerCase()
  return t.startsWith("table of contents") || t.startsWith("contents")
}

/** Get first N sentences from a text string */
function firstSentences(text: string, max = 2): string {
  const sentences = text.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g) || []
  return sentences.slice(0, max).join(" ").trim() || text.slice(0, 200)
}

/** Extract first image URL from HTML content for hero fallback */
function extractFirstImageFromHtml(html?: string): string | null {
  if (!html) return null
  const match = html.match(/&lt;img[^&gt;]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/)
  return match?.[1] || null
}

```
import { notFound } from "next/navigation"
import Script from "next/script"
import type { Metadata } from "next"
import { fetchArticleBySlug, fetchLatestArticles } from "@/lib/payload"
import { getSiteContext } from "@/lib/site"
import { ArticleLayout } from "@/components/article/ArticleLayout"
import {
  getCanonicalUrl,
  getMetaTitle,
  getMetaDescription,
  getRobotsDirective,
  getMediaUrl,
  generateStructuredData,
  estimateReadTime,
} from "@/lib/seo"
import { addHeadingIds } from "@/lib/lexical"

export const revalidate = 60

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise&lt;{ slug: string }&gt;
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise&lt;Metadata&gt; {
  const { slug } = await params
  const article = await fetchArticleBySlug(slug)
  const site = await getSiteContext()

  if (!article) {
    return { title: "Article Not Found" }
  }

  const title = getMetaTitle(article, site)
  const description = getMetaDescription(article)
  const canonical = getCanonicalUrl(article)
  const featuredImageUrl = getMediaUrl(article.featuredImage)
  const siteName = site?.name || "Wine Country Corner"

  return {
    title,
    description,
    robots: getRobotsDirective(article),
    alternates: {
      canonical,
    },
    openGraph: {
      type: "article",
      title: article.metaTitle || article.title,
      description,
      url: canonical,
      siteName,
      locale: "en_US",
      publishedTime: article.publishedAt || article.publishedDate || undefined,
      modifiedTime: article.updatedAt || undefined,
      authors: article.author?.name ? [article.author.name] : undefined,
      section: article.categories?.[0]?.title,
      tags: article.tags?.map((t) =&gt; t.name),
      images: featuredImageUrl
        ? [
            {
              url: featuredImageUrl,
              width: article.featuredImage?.width || 1200,
              height: article.featuredImage?.height || 630,
              alt: article.featuredImage?.alt || article.title,
            },
          ]
        : undefined,
    },
    twitter: {
      card: "summary_large_image",
      title: article.metaTitle || article.title,
      description,
      images: featuredImageUrl ? [featuredImageUrl] : undefined,
    },
  }
}

export default async function ArticlePage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const [article, site] = await Promise.all([
    fetchArticleBySlug(slug),
    getSiteContext(),
  ])

  if (!article) notFound()

  // Get related articles from same category
  const categorySlug = article.categories?.[0]?.slug
  let related: typeof article[] = []
  if (categorySlug) {
    const all = await fetchLatestArticles({ limit: 5 })
    related = all.filter((a) =&gt; a.slug !== article.slug).slice(0, 4)
  }

  // Use pre-rendered HTML only for WordPress-imported articles.
  // Native Lexical content is rendered directly via RichText — no HTML conversion.
  const importedContent = article.importedHtml || article.html
  const htmlContent = importedContent?.trim()
    ? addHeadingIds(importedContent)
    : ""

  // Calculate read time if not provided
  const readTime = article.readTime || estimateReadTime(article.content, &#96;${article.title} ${article.excerpt || ""}&#96;)

  // Generate structured data
  const structuredData = generateStructuredData(article, site, htmlContent)

  return (
    &lt;&gt;
      {/* JSON-LD Structured Data */}
      &lt;Script
        id="article-structured-data"
        type="application/ld+json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: structuredData }}
      /&gt;
      &lt;ArticleLayout
        article={{ ...article, readTime }}
        related={related}
        htmlContent={htmlContent}
      /&gt;
    &lt;/&gt;
  )
}

```
